package student

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

type AssignedLessonPathReader interface {
	GetLearningPathByID(context.Context, string, string) (domain.StudentLearningPath, error)
}

// AssignedLessonContext reads only Student's exact frozen path. It has no
// mutable Course dependency and performs no progression or assignment writes.
type AssignedLessonContext struct{ Paths AssignedLessonPathReader }

func (useCase AssignedLessonContext) Handle(ctx context.Context, studentID, pathID, itemID string) (domain.AssignedLessonContext, error) {
	for _, value := range []string{studentID, pathID, itemID} {
		parsed, err := uuid.Parse(value)
		if err != nil || parsed == uuid.Nil || parsed.String() != value {
			return domain.AssignedLessonContext{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
	}
	if useCase.Paths == nil {
		return domain.AssignedLessonContext{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	path, err := useCase.Paths.GetLearningPathByID(ctx, studentID, pathID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.AssignedLessonContext{}, err
	}
	if path.ID != pathID || path.StudentID != studentID {
		return domain.AssignedLessonContext{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return domain.ProjectAssignedLessonContext(path, itemID)
}
